ai.instructions: Spark tools act on the user's mail, calendar, contacts, and meetings through the Spark Desktop app running on this computer. Read the use-spark skill before the first Spark tool call, and follow a recipe or persona skill when the user's request matches one.

skills.name: use-spark
skills.title: Use Spark
skills.description: Use the Spark MCP server to access and act on the user's Spark email data - list emails, search by topic, read threads, check calendar events, find availability, look up contacts, view team info, draft messages (from scratch or saved templates), send drafts, share drafts with teammates, post team comments, triage threads, create/update/delete calendar events and manage attendees, and manage contacts. Use when the user asks about their emails, calendar, contacts, meetings, scheduling, or wants to send, reply, archive, snooze, assign, comment, categorize, or schedule.

skills.name: persona-exec-assistant
skills.title: Persona: Exec Assistant
skills.description: Executive assistant persona for Spark. Morning briefings, draft replies, schedule management, and contact lookup.

skills.name: persona-founder
skills.title: Persona: Founder
skills.description: Founder / CEO persona for Spark. High-volume triage, aggressive delegation, cross-team oversight, and selective engagement.

skills.name: persona-freelancer
skills.title: Persona: Freelancer
skills.description: Freelancer / solo operator persona for Spark. Multi-client management, invoice follow-ups, availability, and quick responses.

skills.name: persona-meeting-manager
skills.title: Persona: Meeting Manager
skills.description: Meeting manager persona for Spark. Meeting preparation, transcript review, follow-up drafts, and scheduling.

skills.name: persona-project-manager
skills.title: Persona: Project Manager
skills.description: Project manager persona for Spark. Project thread tracking, stakeholder updates, action item extraction, and cross-team coordination.

skills.name: persona-sales-rep
skills.title: Persona: Sales Rep
skills.description: Sales rep / account manager persona for Spark. Client relationship tracking, pipeline review, follow-up cadence, and deal context.

skills.name: persona-support-agent
skills.title: Persona: Support Agent
skills.description: Support agent persona for Spark. Shared inbox processing, assignment, templated responses, and escalation via delegation.

skills.name: persona-team-lead
skills.title: Persona: Team Lead
skills.description: Team lead persona for Spark. Team workload review, assignment distribution, shared inbox triage, and standup preparation.

skills.name: recipe-calendar-audit
skills.title: Calendar Audit
skills.description: Analyze meeting load over a time range: total meetings, meeting hours, busiest days, back-to-back chains, and free blocks.

skills.name: recipe-delegate-and-track
skills.title: Delegate and Track
skills.description: Assign emails to teammates with context and track delegation status.

skills.name: recipe-draft-batch
skills.title: Draft Batch
skills.description: Review and finalize multiple pending drafts in a batch session: read context, edit, or discard.

skills.name: recipe-end-of-day
skills.title: End of Day
skills.description: End-of-day review: check for loose ends, review pinned items, and preview tomorrow's calendar.

skills.name: recipe-inbox-by-category
skills.title: Inbox by Category
skills.description: Process inbox in priority order by Spark's smart categories: priority first, then people, invites, notifications, newsletters.

skills.name: recipe-inbox-zero
skills.title: Inbox Zero
skills.description: Process inbox to zero using category-first triage: review by category, read threads, then archive, move, or mark done.

skills.name: recipe-invitation-manager
skills.title: Invitation Manager
skills.description: Process pending calendar invitations: check availability and present a decision list with recommendations.

skills.name: recipe-label-organize
skills.title: Label Organize
skills.description: Organize emails with labels and folders: attach labels, detach wrong ones, and move misfiled emails.

skills.name: recipe-meeting-followup
skills.title: Meeting Followup
skills.description: Review a meeting transcript and draft follow-up emails with action items to attendees.

skills.name: recipe-meeting-prep
skills.title: Meeting Prep
skills.description: Prepare for an upcoming meeting: check agenda, search for email context, look up attendee details, and flag open threads that should be raised.

skills.name: recipe-morning-standup
skills.title: Morning Standup
skills.description: Morning standup briefing: today's events, unread people and priority mail, and team assignment status.

skills.name: recipe-multi-account-review
skills.title: Multi Account Review
skills.description: Review inbox status across multiple email accounts with per-account breakdown and cross-account priorities.

skills.name: recipe-new-sender-review
skills.title: New Sender Review
skills.description: Process GateKeeper's new sender queue: review, accept legitimate contacts, and block unwanted senders.

skills.name: recipe-newsletter-cleanup
skills.title: Newsletter Cleanup
skills.description: Audit newsletter subscriptions: block unwanted senders, unsubscribe from mailing lists, and enable AI summaries for worth-keeping ones.

skills.name: recipe-notification-hygiene
skills.title: Notification Hygiene
skills.description: Tame notification overload by reclassifying noisy senders, grouping repetitive notifications, and bulk-archiving cleared alerts.

skills.name: recipe-priority-tuning
skills.title: Priority Tuning
skills.description: Fine-tune Spark's priority category by marking key contacts as primary and adjusting notification importance.

skills.name: recipe-schedule-meeting
skills.title: Schedule Meeting
skills.description: Find mutual availability with attendees and suggest meeting times.

skills.name: recipe-shared-inbox-status
skills.title: Shared Inbox Status
skills.description: Review shared inbox health: open vs. done items, unassigned work, and per-member assignment breakdown.

skills.name: recipe-shared-inbox-triage
skills.title: Shared Inbox Triage
skills.description: Process open items in shared inboxes: review, assign, respond, or mark done.

skills.name: recipe-stakeholder-brief
skills.title: Stakeholder Brief
skills.description: Build a comprehensive dossier on a person by pulling all meetings they attended and email threads with them into a single relationship brief.

skills.name: recipe-team-workload
skills.title: Team Workload
skills.description: Audit team assignment distribution: per-member loads, delegated items, unassigned work, and workload imbalances.

skills.name: recipe-topic-timeline
skills.title: Topic Timeline
skills.description: Build a chronological narrative for a topic by interleaving meeting transcript excerpts and email thread summaries across a time range.

skills.name: recipe-unsubscribe-audit
skills.title: Unsubscribe Audit
skills.description: Full unsubscribe audit: scan inbox, archive, and GateKeeper for newsletter senders, classify by volume and engagement, detect phishing and duplicate subscriptions, then unsubscribe via the action tool or extracted footer links.

skills.name: recipe-vacation-catchup
skills.title: Vacation Catchup
skills.description: Process a large email backlog after time away: assess by category, batch-archive noise, and surface what needs attention.

skills.name: recipe-weekly-digest
skills.title: Weekly Digest
skills.description: Weekly summary: this week's meetings, unread email breakdown by category, and team assignment status.

preferences.name: sparkPath
preferences.title: Spark CLI Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the spark CLI. Leave empty to auto-detect: /usr/local/bin/spark on Mac, spark.exe from your PATH on Windows.
